description: Use when an agent checks whether a U.S. company's officers, directors or 10% owners are buying or selling its stock. Input: ticker or cik, optional days (1-365, default 90), type (all, open_market, buy, sell), limit (Form 4 filings, 1-40). Output: JSON open-market buy and sell totals, net value, insider counts, 10b5-1 sells, signal (cluster_buying...), each transaction with role, code, shares, price, value, holdings after and filing link. Example: ?ticker=AAPL Price: $0.006 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

cik.description: Issuer SEC CIK (e.g. 320193); give ticker or cik

limit.description: Newest Form 4 filings to read in the window (1-40, default 20)

ticker.description: U.S. issuer ticker (AAPL, BRK.B); give ticker or cik

type.description: all transactions, open_market (P and S), buy (P) or sell (S)

name: sec_insider_trades
title: U.S. insider trading from SEC Form 4: officer and director buys and sells, values, 10b5-1 plans, cluster-buying signal
